title: 3rd + mixed conditionals
recall: 3-shart va aralash shart gap tuzilishi qanday? Had I known… inversiyasini ayt.
formula: 3: if + had V3, would have V3 — o'tmishdagi xayoliy (If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus)
mixed: if + had V3, would + V1 (o'tmish → hozirgi natija) — If I had studied medicine, I'd be a doctor now
inversiya: Had I known… / Were I you… / Should you need…

pairs.a: If I had known, I would have come.
pairs.b: If I had known, I would be there now.

items.uz: Agar ertaroq chiqqanimda, avtobusga ulgurgan bo'lardim.
en: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus.
If I'd left earlier, I'd have caught the bus.

items.uz: Agar bilganimda, senga aytgan bo'lardim.
en: If I had known, I would have told you.
If I'd known, I'd have told you.

items.uz: Agar u ogohlantirmaganda, biz adashib qolgan bo'lardik.
en: If he hadn't warned us, we would have got lost.
If he hadn't warned us, we would have gotten lost.

items.uz: Agar tibbiyotni o'qiganimda, hozir shifokor bo'lardim.
en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If I'd studied medicine, I'd be a doctor now.

items.uz: Agar kecha kechgacha o'tirmaganimda, hozir charchamagan bo'lardim.
en: If I hadn't stayed up late last night, I wouldn't be tired now.
If I hadn't gone to bed late, I wouldn't be tired now.

items.uz: Agar u aqlliroq bo'lganda, bu xatoni qilmagan bo'lardi.
en: If he were smarter, he wouldn't have made that mistake.
If he was cleverer, he wouldn't have made this mistake.

items.uz: Agar xaritani olganimizda, yo'lni topgan bo'lardik.
en: If we had taken a map, we would have found the way.
If we'd taken a map, we'd have found the way.

items.uz: Bilganimda, kelgan bo'lardim. (inversiya)
en: Had I known, I would have come.

items.uz: Agar yomg'ir yog'maganda, o'yin bo'lib o'tgan bo'lardi.
en: If it hadn't rained, the match would have taken place.
If it hadn't rained, the game would have happened.

items.uz: Agar u yordam bermaganda, men hali ham ishsiz bo'lardim.
en: If he hadn't helped me, I would still be unemployed.
If he hadn't helped me, I'd still be without a job.

items.uz: Agar men o'sha ishni olganimda, hozir Toshkentda yashardim.
en: If I had taken that job, I would live in Tashkent now.
If I'd taken that job, I'd be living in Tashkent now.

items.uz: Agar sen qo'ng'iroq qilganingda, kutib turgan bo'lardim.
en: If you had called, I would have waited.
If you'd called, I'd have waited.

items.uz: Agar u shunchalik tez haydamaganda, avariya bo'lmagan bo'lardi.
en: If he hadn't driven so fast, the accident wouldn't have happened.
If he hadn't been driving so fast, there wouldn't have been an accident.

items.uz: Agar ingliz tilini bolaligimda o'rganganimda, hozir erkin gapirardim.
en: If I had learned English as a child, I would speak it fluently now.
If I'd learnt English as a child, I'd speak fluently now.

items.uz: Agar biz yutganimizda, finalga chiqqan bo'lardik.
en: If we had won, we would have reached the final.
If we'd won, we'd have got to the final.

items.uz: Agar men sen bo'lganimda, u pulni olmagan bo'lardim.
en: If I were you, I wouldn't have taken that money.
If I'd been you, I wouldn't have taken the money.

items.uz: Agar u o'sha samolyotga chiqqanda, hozir tirik bo'lmasdi.
en: If he had got on that plane, he wouldn't be alive now.
If he had taken that plane, he wouldn't be alive today.

items.uz: Agar ertaroq uxlaganimda, imtihonda yaxshiroq natija ko'rsatgan bo'lardim.
en: If I had slept earlier, I would have done better in the exam.
If I'd gone to bed earlier, I'd have done better in the exam.

items.uz: Agar sizga yordam kerak bo'lsa, qo'ng'iroq qiling. (inversiya, rasmiy)
en: Should you need any help, please call.
Should you need help, please call us.

items.uz: Agar u kechirim so'raganda, men uni kechirgan bo'lardim.
en: If he had apologised, I would have forgiven him.
If he had apologized, I would have forgiven him.

speak: Hayotingizdagi 3 ta muhim qaror: boshqacha qilganingizda nima bo'lardi? (3-shart)
O'tmishdagi bir voqea hozirgi hayotingizga qanday ta'sir qildi? (mixed)
Rasmiy xat uslubida 2 ta inversiya: Should you… / Had we…
